title_en: On the way to a picnic

lines.en: Jiwoo, do you have a phone charger?
Yes, I've got one in my bag. Here.
lines.sp: Yeah, I've gad-one in my bag. Here.
lines.hk: 예, 아이브 가런 인 마이 백. 히어.

lines.en: Thanks. My phone only has five percent left.
lines.sp: Thanks. My phone only has five percent lef'.
lines.hk: 땡스. 마이 폰 온리 해즈 파이브 퍼센트 레프.

lines.en: You look pale, Jake. Are you okay?
lines.sp: You look pale, Jake. Ya okay?
lines.hk: 유 룩 페일, 제익. 여 오케이?

lines.en: I have some medicine. And I have a lot of water here.
lines.sp: I have some medicine. 'N I hava lodda wader here.
lines.hk: 아이 해브 썸 메디슨. 은 아이 해버 라러 워러 히어.
lines.ko: 약이 있어요. 그리고 여기 물도 많아요.

lines.en: Thanks. Do we have any snacks?
lines.sp: Thanks. Do we have any snacks?

lines.en: We have some kimbap, but we don't have any milk.
lines.sp: We have some kimbap, but we don' have any milk.
lines.hk: 위 해브 썸 김밥, 벗 위 돈 해배니 밀크.

lines.en: That's okay. I've got everything I need.
lines.sp: That's okay. I've gad-everything I need.
lines.hk: 댓츠 오케이. 아이브 가레브리씽 아이 니드.
